name: TEYU CW-5000TITY active spindle chiller
description: 220-240 V active compressor chiller, nominal 750 W, +/-0.3 C temperature stability and TI pump rated 10 L/min. Verify installed flow, thermal duty and alarm wiring; no spindle-process accuracy approval is implied.

geometryEvidence.summary: Manufacturer publishes CW-5000TITY 580 x 290 x 470 mm overall size, 10 mm fast water connectors and 22 kg net mass.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Undimensioned feet, handle, vents, ports and controls are reconstructed installation contours. Mounting-hole positions and internal compressor/radiator geometry are unpublished. Nominal 750 W and rated pump flow are not an installed duty guarantee; obtain the delivered execution manual and cooling performance at the selected ambient/setpoint.

attributeConditions.nominalCoolingWatts: Nominal manufacturer capacity; actual duty depends on ambient and setpoint. Confirm against measured spindle heat input.
attributeConditions.ratedFlowLitersPerMinute: Rated pump flow, not verified installed flow through the spindle and hoses.
attributeConditions.pumpMaxPressureBar: Maximum pressure; do not assume 10 L/min and 2.5 bar occur simultaneously.

specifications.label: Electrical execution
specifications.value: CW-5000TITY: 1 phase 220-240 V, 50/60 Hz, maximum input 0.67/0.73 kW; confirm delivered nameplate.

specifications.label: Temperature control
specifications.value: 5-35 C control range, +/-0.3 C stability. Select a setpoint respecting the spindle maker's cooling and condensation instructions.

specifications.label: Water circuit
specifications.value: 8 L reservoir; TI pump rated 10 L/min, maximum 2.5 bar; 10 mm fast connectors. Qualify pressure drop, coolant compatibility, measured flow and flow/temperature alarm inhibit.
